name: Mesnac Co., Ltd.
summary: Mesnac Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, and innovation of application software and information equipment for rubber industry in China and internationally. The company offers mixing solutions; mixer feeding systems; chemical weighing systems; rubber grinding and blending systems; volumetric metering systems; information management and control platform; one-step mixing system; batch-off line equipment; open mill automatic mixing systems; inner-liner production lines; pin type cold feed extruders; APH-2 AT-3 apex lines; steel cord belt cutters; steel cord ply cutting lines; and fabric and textile ply cutters.
